steps.text: The breeze in the mountains is ever crisp and cool.
And mornings as refreshing as these are always fine for settling muddy, murky matters.
In a mountain-sat village, when kitchen's smoke has just sprung up, the snow still unreceded in spring, one old and one young stand off against each other.
The only sound, the single strike of a faraway gong.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: You've kept me waiting.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Tch. Bloody lout... Light, stay cool for the moment.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: I've seen you before. Hmm. So it was you.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Unexpected, for sure. A Rim Billitonian, silently lurking in Shangshu since the very beginning.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: I can't understand you, sorry.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Light!

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: What—?!

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: A snare?

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: You train these slumberfoots well. An ordinary woman would be headfirst in the ground by now.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: (He didn't just notice the snare behind him, he stepped on the rope without hesitation... Bastard...)

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Don't worry, I won't make this hard for you, girl.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Do you know what that goblet you're holding is?

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: It's not my concern, or my interest. It's newbie bounty hunters that ask too many questions.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Then you have only yourself to blame.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Don't get so full of yourself! Helmet! Drill!

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: If you don't know what it is, then be wise and hand it over. Don't be used for nothing.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: H-How dare you do that to Helmet—! You asked for it!

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: ...A headless bolt.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: (H-He caught it barehanded? At this distance?! And I *just* changed the string on my crossbow—!)

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Fine.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Seeing how you're unwilling to take my life, I'll give you one chance.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Hand over the goblet to me, and then tell the one instructing you: Tread carefully. Don't be selfish.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Hmph. You know who hired me?

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Whether I know or not doesn't matter. What matters is I can stop you, right here.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Why should I listen to you?

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: You have no choice.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Maybe you can run, but you could never bear to see these beasts of yours meet a sorry fate.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: You're threatening me?

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: You have skill. But aside from your crossbow, you've got nothing in a fight.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: You can pull out before you're in too deep. You need a good eye and the right people, if you want to survive here.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: True. They never told me someone as capable as you would get in the way.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: If I had someone do something dangerous for me, I wouldn't give them the whole picture either.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: It's just a job to you, stranger. Why stake your life on it?

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Give the cup to me, and I vow on the Escorts' name that whatever they're paying you, we'll double it.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Hah, I was taking a loss anyway with all my volunteer work.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Call this a favor for a friend.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: A friend.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: So even you bandits of the wild don't mind a sacrifice for a friend.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Sounds like you've got something against us.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: No... not at all.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: The longer you do business, the more fine people you meet, the less friends you end up with.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Then be smart, and go back to your business.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Yes, business is always easiest done in the mountains.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Three Mounts, Seventeen Peaks, hundreds of passes. Is there any road without a teahouse and station for travelers to rest their feet? Is there any road... without our people?

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: I hope you see clear now, girl.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: You really don't think anything of me.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: A direct confrontation might not be my style, but you've pissed me off just far enough... isn't that right, my darlings?

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: (Rim Billitonian) The old todger wants to have a go, let's give 'im a go! We've been around the paddock a few times, we're no strangers!

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Some just refuse to learn.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: If that's your answer, then you'll pay the—
Even if a third party was stood there watching, they wouldn't have a clue just how the coming step came to land.
Simply put, the man is adept in walking passes, in climbing mountains. The steps he lifts and places, day after day after day, are truly too many to count.
In one clean noise, clay bricks shatter in the ground. Before him, dust drifts down. By his gaze is a simple, common bamboo-wood carrying pole. His gaze itself, faint rage.
Far away, the gong strikes again.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: —H-How... Where did he come from... Wait, Light, calm down! And Drill! Back to me...!

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: ...It's you.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: You finally came to the mountains.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: So I came to find you.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: What comes will come. Nothing's avoidable forever. Is there a need to be so hasty?

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Hey. Miss.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: ...Are you talking to me?

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: (His movement—is that wooden stick one of their carrying poles? What did he do just now... to shatter bricks made of stone?)

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Do you know him?

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Then there's some problem between you.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: I only see you between us.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: You're right. I'm your problem, then.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: When I'm done here, I'll come see you. But not now.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Miss. Does this relate to the item in your hands?

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Uh... it does...

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: This is personal business. And major at that. Stay out of it.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: How major?

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: The safety of the nation is at stake! Life and death!

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Since that rainy night those years ago, I've rarely heard you use such a tone.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: I see. How could you be the villain here? What a chivalrous swordsman. What a dutiful innkeeper.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Then get out of the way—

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: —But I know just who you are, and that's why you'll never see me.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: And if you won't, then it changes nothing if I find you. That's why I never came down from the mountains.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: So. If...

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Hey! You—!

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Give that back!

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: It was ten years.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Ten years ago, you watched as my son died... so you could protect this goblet.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Shang Zhong!

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Miss. This is nothing to do with you now.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: You steal my things while I'm not looking, and then tell me it's not my business?!

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: This was never yours.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Shang Zhong, have you lost it?!

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: You're free to go now.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Shang Zhong!

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Leave!

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Grr...!

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Mark my words, you two... I'll be back for it!

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Zheng Qingyue... Where's your blade?

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: At home.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: I see. At home.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: That rainy night, in the escort, over a dozen lost their lives. There was a boy among them, and a father.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: The boy was a Shang. My boy. The father was a Du. Du Yaoye's father.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: That's why you don't carry your blade.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: What a tremendous joke.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: You still hate me to this day.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: I don't hate you. I know you didn't mean to. The blame lies with you, but no fault.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: 'Save the goods, then the men,' hm?

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Yet the goods are gone now, and so are the men. Am I still not allowed to condemn you?

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: I must ask you give justification, or else I cannot live on.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: I will. Give me the goblet. Do you know what it entails—

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: No. He died for this cup then. I'll bury it beside him today.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: I'll be waiting atop the mountain, for you to fetch your blade.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Master Shen!

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Mm? What brought you over here? I was about to look for you at Liang's.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Where's young Lee?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: The goblet got stolen. Mr. Lee sent us to fetch you.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Did he tell you anything about this?

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: He asked you to come get me, but not to first find Mr. Liang?

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: To be clear, you came from the Liang residence?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Er... yeah.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: ...*Sigh*. The fact he didn't send you to find Liang Xun means deep down, he already knows...

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Gifted, how gifted. How truly gifted.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: You're back, Uncle?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: How were things?

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: In regards to her, thoughtful of etiquette, true as can be.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: If she was so ready to display etiquette, that shows there's still room for mediation.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: This is regardless of how she acts, or what intentions she harbors. Master Tai's instructions lie here, and they can't be false.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: She's clever.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Since I visited in an official's capacity, she should have realized to some extent.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Very well.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Both sides are now strained to breaking point. We stand on a hair trigger.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: We can only resolve this incident before we draw even more dispute.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: If we really do want everyone to trust that our methods can forever rid Yan of the sword hanging over her head, then we naturally must obey those magic words—

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: —Frank and forthright.
